description: Video for a messenger. Squeezes the recording to 24 megabytes — a size that passes both mail and messengers. The bitrate is computed for your file; the audio stays. Accepts video/*, .mp4, .mov, .mkv, .webm, .avi, .m4v; up to 500 MB per file.

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

name: video_for-messenger
